schemes.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
schemes.clause_cited: PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines 2019, Section 2.1 (Small and Marginal Farmers Scheme)
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
schemes.clause_cited: PM-JAY Guidelines 2018, Eligibility Criteria based on SECC 2011 deprivation indicators (D1 to D7)
schemes.benefit: Free secondary and tertiary healthcare cover up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year
schemes.benefit_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ्त कैशलेस इलाज

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
schemes.clause_cited: Ujjwala 2.0 Guidelines 2021, Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, Clause 3 (Release of LPG connections to poor households)
schemes.benefit: Deposit-free LPG connection, first refill free, and hotplate/stove free of cost
schemes.benefit_hi: मुफ्त एलपीजी कनेक्शन, पहला भरा सिलेंडर और गैस चूल्हा बिल्कुल मुफ्त

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.clause_cited: PFRDA APY Scheme Regulations 2015, Eligibility & Exit Criteria
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension between ₹1,000 and ₹5,000 after attaining 60 years of age
schemes.benefit_hi: 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 तक की गारंटीड मासिक पेंशन

schemes.name: UP Mukhyamantri Kisan Durghatna Bima Yojana
schemes.name_hi: यूपी मुख्यमंत्री किसान दुर्घटना कल्याण योजना
schemes.clause_cited: UP Revenue Dept Order No. 451/2020 (Accidental Insurance Scheme for Farmers and Agricultural Laborers)
schemes.benefit: Financial compensation of up to ₹5 Lakh in accidental demise or total disability for agricultural workers
schemes.benefit_hi: दुर्घटना में मृत्यु या दिव्यांगता पर किसान/बटाईदार/श्रमिक के परिवार को ₹5 लाख तक की आर्थिक सहायता
